title: DSPA: Dynamic SAE Steering for Data-Efficient Preference Alignment
abstract: arXiv:2603.21461v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Preference alignment is usually achieved by weight-updating training on preference data, which adds substantial alignment-stage compute and provides limited mechanistic visibility. We propose Dynamic SAE Steering for Preference Alignment (DSPA), an inference-time method that makes sparse autoencoder (SAE) steering prompt-conditional. From preference triples, DSPA computes a conditional-difference map linking prompt features to generation-control features; during decoding, it modifies only token-active latents, without base-model weight updates. Across Gemma-2-2B/9B and Qwen3-8B, DSPA improves MT-Bench and is competitive on AlpacaEval while preserving multiple-choice accuracy. Under restricted preference data, DSPA remains robust and can rival the two-stage RAHF-SCIT pipeline while requiring up to $4.47\times$ fewer alignment-stage FLOPs. translated_title: DSPA：面向数据高效偏好对齐的动态稀疏自编码器引导方法
translated_abstract: 偏好对齐通常通过在偏好数据上进行权重更新的训练来实现，这种方式会增加大量的对齐阶段计算，且机制可解释性有限。我们提出了用于偏好对齐的动态SAE引导方法（DSPA），这是一种推理时方法，使稀疏自编码器（SAE）引导具备提示条件性。DSPA从偏好三元组中计算出条件差分映射，将提示特征与生成控制特征关联起来；在解码过程中，它仅修改令牌激活的潜在变量，无需更新基础模型权重。在Gemma-2-2B/9B和Qwen3-8B模型上，DSPA提升了MT-Bench成绩，在AlpacaEval上具有竞争力，同时保持了多项选择任务的准确率。在偏好数据受限的情况下，DSPA依然保持稳健，能够与两阶段RAHF-SCIT流程相媲美，同时所需的对齐阶段FLOPs最多减少4.47倍。最后，我们审计了DSPA所修改的SAE特征，发现偏好方向主要由……
tldr: DSPA是一种推理时偏好对齐方法，通过提示条件化的稀疏自编码器引导在不更新模型权重的情况下实现偏好对齐，在保持性能的同时将对齐阶段计算量最多降低4.47倍。
en_tdlr: DSPA is an inference-time preference alignment method that uses prompt-conditional SAE steering to align models without weight updates, reducing alignment-stage FLOPs by up to 4.47× while maintaining competitive performance.
